description: Implementation of TaxRateDao interface for accessing TaxRate entities from the database, including methods for listing, retrieving by code or ID, and filtering by store, country, zone, and tax class.

classes.name: TaxRateDaoImpl
classes.description: Data Access Object implementation for TaxRate entity, providing database query methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRate objects associated with a specific MerchantStore, filtered by language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate object by its code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate object by its ID.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists TaxRate objects filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists TaxRate objects filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.
